Group-level, whole-brain random-effects task contrast of an attention/adding task vs control meets global voxelwise and task-solving criteria; this analysis represents the pooled problem-solving network across domains.
The task is the Paced Visual Serial Addition Test (digits presented and mental addition required); group whole-brain activation for adding vs control meets mathematical problem solving inclusion.
The stimuli and task are numeric (digits and arithmetic addition), not letter/word/sentence based; does not meet VERBAL_PROBLEM_SOLVING_I1 (verbal stimuli required).
The task uses numeric digit stimuli and arithmetic operations rather than pictorial or spatial problem stimuli; does not meet VISUOSPATIAL_PROBLEM_SOLVING_I1.
This contrast (adding vs control) does not manipulate problem difficulty/complexity (no harder>easier manipulation); it does not meet LOGICAL_REASONING_I1 (demand/difficulty contrast required).

Group-level, whole-brain random-effects contrast comparing high vs low speed of the same adding task meets global voxelwise and task-solving criteria; represents pooled problem-solving network across domains.

Task does not involve numerical stimuli or arithmetic manipulation.

This contrast does not manipulate problem difficulty/complexity (no hard>easy or parametric demand contrast); LOGICAL_REASONING_I1 is not met.

This is not a manipulation of problem difficulty/complexity or demand (it is a perceptual matching task), so it does not meet LOGICAL_REASONING_I1 or the global problem-solving requirement (GLOBAL_I2).

This analysis reports RSPM (Raven's matrix) > fixation group-level, whole-brain voxelwise activations in non-autistics. RSPM is a visuospatial fluid reasoning/problem-solving task and meets GLOBAL_I1, GLOBAL_I2 and GLOBAL_I3 (problem-solving task minus baseline).
The task is visuospatial matrix reasoning (Raven's matrices), not number manipulation; it does not meet MATHEMATICAL_PROBLEM_SOLVING_I1.
RSPM uses pictorial/spatial stimuli rather than words or sentences; it does not meet VERBAL_PROBLEM_SOLVING_I1.

RSPM is a canonical visuospatial matrix-reasoning problem; the contrast is a whole-brain, group-level task>fixation map with MNI coordinates, satisfying GLOBAL_I1, GLOBAL_I2 and VISUOSPATIAL_PROBLEM_SOLVING_I1.
This contrast is overall task>fixation and does not manipulate problem difficulty or present a parametric demand contrast, so LOGICAL_REASONING_I1 is not met.

This analysis reports RSPM > fixation activations in autistics (group-level, voxelwise). RSPM is a problem-solving task and the contrast is task>baseline, meeting GLOBAL_I1, GLOBAL_I2 and GLOBAL_I3 and DOMAIN_GENERAL_PROBLEM_SOLVING_I1.
RSPM is visuospatial/pictorial matrix problems rather than numerical manipulation; MATHEMATICAL_PROBLEM_SOLVING_I1 is not met.
